name: kikoeru
description: A self-hosted media server for DLsite voice works — monorepo combining backend (kikoeru-express) and frontend (kikoeru-quasar).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -w backend && npm run version:sync
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -w backend && npm run version:sync
scripts.release:major: npm version major -w backend && npm run version:sync
